label: sparse token-combination feature near copy start (f...p/o/a, short sequences)
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.02% of steps). 65% of mass is at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, input = re-fed first token), with the rest at <DEL> and late original steps; it never fires at t<3 or t>10. It is strongly concentrated in short sequences (L 3-5) whose first token is f (also n, a, 0) and whose next few tokens include p, o or a (next_out p 17x lift). The strongest activations are f-initial sequences such as f a p x / f o p x, at the re-fed f. Still, every conjunction tried (first copy step + f + p/o/a seen + short L) tops out near 0.2 F1 and about 0.2-0.4 mass recall: most matching contexts stay silent, and many activations fall on other first tokens or other steps. No coherent predicate was found.
